name: Runway Api
description: Get guidance for integrating video, image and audio generation with the Runway API and official SDKs. Connect to your Runway Dev account to inspect available models and task errors, manage Model Routers and existing real-time avatars, and inspect recorded routing decisions.
longDescription:
Ships **11 skills**.

- **Skills** (11): `runway-dev` (Foundation for building, modifying, debugging, or verifying Runway Dev Platform integrations in an application: connect Dev MCP, use…), `runway-dev-characters` (Build, modify, debug, or verify Runway Characters integrations: inspect preset or custom avatars with MCP, manage live Sessions…), `runway-dev-model-routers` (Build, modify, debug, or verify Runway Model Routers: inspect live config and eligible models via MCP, manage approved…), `runway-dev-models` (Build, modify, debug, or verify Runway model generation in an application: discover accessible models and constraints with MCP,…), `runway-dev-recipes` (Choose, build, modify, debug, or verify Runway recipe integrations: match a recipe to the user's use case, follow…), `runway-dev-workflows` (Build, modify, debug, or verify integrations that expose Runway app workflows as API endpoints), `rw-check-org-details` (Query the Runway API for organization details: rate limits, credit balance, usage tier, and daily generation counts), `rw-generate-audio` (Generate audio using the Runway API via runnable scripts), and 3 more

Installs with `claude plugin install runway-api@claude-plugins-official` from `runwayml/skills`.
